card.name: Words after previous or prior
card.fires_on: The word right after "previously", "prior", "previous" or "baseline", such as "on", "use", "treated with". It appears in drug-label text about earlier treatment or history.

modes.label: After previously
modes.description: Preposition following "previously" that introduces an earlier dose or drug.
modes.example: For patients previously<< on>> 2.5 mg/kg, resume

modes.label: After prior or baseline
modes.description: Noun "use" following "prior" or "baseline" when describing earlier drug exposure.
modes.example: In this substudy, prior<< use>> of estrogen-alone or estrogen plus progest

card.plain: It marks the spot in a sentence where the label names a drug or condition the patient had before.
